scope: Private per-render membership indexing for caller-provided List<string>; the normal GetCurrentValues HashSet path is not an optimization target.

final_eligibility.options: Materialized exact List<SelectListItem> or SelectListItem[], at least 32 options
final_eligibility.lifetime: One render; no retained metadata or collection cache

requirement_coverage.requirement: Ordinal matching, overriding SelectListItem.Selected, complete ordered grouped/ungrouped HTML
Existing ordinal and ordinal-ignore-case HashSet comparers remain authoritative
A List subclass can reimplement ICollection.Contains; preserve its case-insensitive result and all 32 calls
Opaque ICollection.Contains remains authoritative without any added enumeration or Count access
Actual lazy option enumeration can update selected values before membership indexing
Actual custom option indexer can update selected values during option selection

compatibility.observed_boundary: Public GenerateSelect, HtmlEncoder.Default, complete rendered HTML

tuning.reason: The 16-option/16-value hit case was 6.06% slower with an extra 539 B/op in the first pair.

excluded_claims: No production or weighted overall throughput claim
No behavior change, new public API, process-wide metadata cache or Hot Reload handler
No browser, HTTP-hosted, concurrent-mutation or production workload validation
